deadline.value: December 1 is the priority deadline for financial aid; later applications are considered on a space-available basis.
deadline.quote: The priority deadline for financial aid consideration is December 1.

fee_waiver.value: The department cannot waive the application fee.
fee_waiver.quote: Unfortunately we are not able to waive application fees.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required and are not considered.
gre_general.quote: GRE Scores are not required and will not be considered.

funding.value: PhD applicants who finish by December 1 are considered for fellowship support and a first-year teaching assistantship.
funding.quote: All PhD applicants completing their application prior to December 1 will be considered for department-level fellowship support and a teaching assistantship in their first year.

entry_route.value: You may apply straight from a bachelor's; the department encourages this if the PhD is the goal.
entry_route.quote: Yes, you may apply directly to the PhD program without a master's degree, straight from undergraduate studies.
